svg.title: keyguard: hook speed against budget
svg.desc: Bars start at zero. The pre-commit hook takes 35.5 ms at the median (95th percentile 37.2 ms) against a 150 ms budget. The reference-transaction hook takes 12.1 ms (95th percentile 12.9 ms) against a 40 ms budget. A whole git commit takes 20 ms without the hooks and 104-107 ms with them. A full-history scan of 13 public repos takes 1.7 s. A thin crawler, small glowing dots joined by hairlines, climbs between the two panels and reaches a hairline out to the end of every bar; a spider walks across 13 repo cards as the scan bar grows. A field of 469 dots, one for each repo and gist, lies under the scan time of all of them.

g.text: <> Code Issues Pull requests Actions Security Insights
Reference-transaction runs 7 times per commit; one call does work.
